verification.scope: Only feedback.details.mechanismOrProperty and feedback.details.scenarioApplication changed for all 18 objects; no semantic acceptance.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A scalar count is the consumed information; transferring reservation objects adds data this response never uses.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Because reservation details are never opened here, the row can show its count without transferring child records.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A read projection can calculate an aggregate without materializing the related entities.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The 40 station rows need a count; the screen never transfers reservation records.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The page boundary limits which gardener records belong to the response; loading the whole garden ignores that scope.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Only gardeners associated with the returned plot page are needed to build these rows.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A page boundary limits the root records whose related values belong in the response.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Only gardeners for the 25 returned plots need to be present in this page.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Counts and latest times are aggregates, so annotation entities do not contribute fields the report needs.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The returned report consists of two measures rather than annotation content.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Aggregate queries return measures without creating annotation objects or loading their fields.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The archive report receives count and latest time, not annotation text or profile data.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The serializer runs after the bounded transaction, so a deferred name read cannot satisfy the export.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Each export row must already include the approver name at transaction close.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Deferred relationship access is unsafe when serialization occurs outside the read scope.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Approver names are already present in each exported row when the transaction closes.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The selected view consumes the complete but explicitly capped grant set during one request.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The twelve-row cap makes the complete grant detail part of this selected-principal response.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A bounded child collection can be materialized when the caller consumes all of it.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The selected title view displays all 12 current grants and their expiry dates.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The large notes belong to a later user action and should not burden the fleet summary.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Opening a particular aircraft is the only action that consumes its large service notes.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Separating list and detail shapes avoids carrying large payloads for unselected rows.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The fleet report keeps each aircraft’s date; notes arrive only after selection.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Capacity is the only related value this directory consumes; patient records add unrelated data.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The directory can display capacity without fetching patient-side relationships.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A projection can include one required related scalar without traversing unrelated relationships.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Clinic capacity appears without retrieving referral or medical-note records.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Thirty separate owner reads would exceed the endpoint’s stated two-read budget.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The thirty owner values fit in the one related-data read allowed after the meter page.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Batching related values keeps read count independent of the number of parent rows.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The 30 owner names fit in the single related-data read allowed for this refresh.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A per-assignment query makes the number of reads grow with page rows, contrary to the request cap.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The shift page can return its row labels without increasing reads as assignments are added.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A bounded page can fetch related labels in a fixed read budget rather than per-row.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Adding assignments to a page does not add database round trips for their skill labels.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The list and detail consume different amounts of data; fetching a megabyte log for each list row has no caller benefit.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Experiment ID and dataset revision identify a list row; the execution log belongs to result detail.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: List and detail queries can select different columns according to their callers.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The large log is absent from search rows and fetched only for an opened result.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The decision uses the evidence before the bounded read scope ends, so deferred access is too late.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The inspector has the selected return evidence while deciding, before leaving the read scope.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Evidence needed for a decision must be available before the bounded read scope ends.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The inspection photos and history are accessible while the inspector submits the decision.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The search response does not need the body that a separate page displays.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Notice text is absent from search and is fetched only on the separate notice page.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A result projection avoids loading fields that belong to a later user action.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Search rows carry notice ID, effective time, and platform; body text stays on the notice page.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Current metadata is sufficient for this edit; historical renditions are not part of the form.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The edit uses current descriptive values; no historical rendition is displayed or changed.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: An edit query can load current values without traversing historical versions.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The form edits current metadata and leaves rendition history unopened.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The detail request shows a bounded set for one principal; unrelated grants and principals do not affect it.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The response contains active grant expiries for one selected principal within its two-read budget.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A selected-principal boundary limits which grants and expiry values the query needs.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Only that principal’s at-most-ten active grants appear in the detail response.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A catalog summary can answer search without loading components the user has not opened.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Component detail becomes relevant only after the user opens one bundle.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Summary reads can aggregate component information before any component collection is needed.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Search returns bundle count and price; component records wait for bundle selection.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Revision metadata answers the search; the binary is needed only for a selected row.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: Revision number and seal time identify each result row before any binary download.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Metadata can identify a revision without transferring its content bytes.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The row displays revision number and seal time; bytes download only after selection.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Totals are the dashboard output; individual payout rows are only needed in seller detail.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The dashboard can report settlement-window totals without materializing seller payout details.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: Grouped totals answer a summary caller without materializing the detail rows behind them.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: Settlement-window totals appear on the dashboard; payout rows stay in seller detail.

priorDetails.mechanismOrProperty: The operation needs a bounded recent page and current balance; older allocations have a separate search path.
priorDetails.scenarioApplication: The recent allocation page and balance support this account operation while lifetime history stays separate.

currentDetails.mechanismOrProperty: A bounded recent page and a separate history query serve different read scopes.
currentDetails.scenarioApplication: The account operation uses balance plus 12 recent allocations, not lifetime history.
